projectDescription: Script.it is an AI-powered automation platform that lets you describe workflows in plain English and instantly build, run, and schedule them against 600+ integrations.
keyFeatures: Conversational AI agent builds and edits automation workflows from plain-English prompts
Script DSL — YAML-based workflow definitions with typed blocks (executable, markdown)
600+ prebuilt integrations via Composio (Slack, Gmail, Notion, HubSpot, and more)
Schedule triggers (cron / recurring) and webhook triggers for event-driven automation
Isolated sandbox execution environment per session with file management
Real-time SSE streaming of agent progress and block execution results
Template library for common use cases (SEO blog, weekly reports, competitor research)
Usage-based credits with optional spend limits and Stripe billing
publicApiSurface: POST /api/session/{id}/prompt — send a chat message to the AI agent
GET /session/:id/events — SSE stream for live agent updates
POST /api/integrations/connect — initiate OAuth or API-key integration flow
GET /api/credits — retrieve usage and credit balance
flow.script.yaml — Script DSL definition file (name, description, blocks)
Webhook trigger endpoint — receive external events to fire a script
